office_does: The auditor records deeds and documents, keeps the county's financial accounts, and runs voter registration and elections in Lincoln County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Chandra Schumacher, appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lincoln County Auditor since a 2021 appointment; a CPA and former Eastern Washington University Foundation budget officer.
highlights: CPA; former EWU Foundation chief budget officer and Odessa Union Grain Growers CFO [S1]
Statement stresses modernizing processes and transparent elections [S1]
